title: Disciple of Moon
summary: Challenge the Disciple of Moon at the hidden monk trial location.
overview: Challenge the Disciple of Moon at the hidden monk trial location.

roles.label: Everyone
tips: Gather support before speaking the challenge and finish the fight within its combat deadline.

sections.title: Encounter plan
bullets: An eligible monk near the trap receives a prompt to prove themselves.
Saying 'prove' in the proximity area summons the disciple.
Entering combat starts a thirty-minute despawn timer.

notes: Approval E406. Source review only; deployment, database spell lists and live balance have not been verified.
